requirements.enforcement: Séparation des lecteurs/migrations et des validations éditoriales; contrats de schéma propres aux artefacts.
requirements.note: La compatibilité technique ne réduit pas les normes éditoriales courantes.

requirements.statement: During FR→EN editorial translation, treat the English target page as if it did not exist and do not reuse its content, metadata, warnings, progress, references or relations as translation input.
requirements.note: Technical remote-publication checks remain separate and may still inspect the target revision.

requirements.statement: Build related-debates only from French débats-connexes whose English counterpart page is verified to exist; omit missing counterparts and never add a relation absent from the French source.

Every translation batch is closed only after a distinct FR→EN verification pass covering metadata mapping, related-debate existence, semantic equivalence, argument polarity, idiomatic English, residual French wikicode and documentary adaptation.

Translate the exact source values of avancement/progress and Debate/Argument title and page warnings according to the exhaustive owner-approved FR→EN mapping; never replace a source value with a creation default.
requirements.note: Covers all owner-provided allowed values for Debate and Argument metadata.

requirements.statement: If one of the mapped metadata parameters is absent in French, keep the corresponding English parameter absent; an unknown source value requires review rather than approximation.

A large Work or agent delivery may aggregate several internally reviewed translation units, but examples, checklists and prior accepted pages are quality constraints rather than drafting templates; each page must be interpreted from its own French content and relevant sources.

For a known English argument name, same-reasoning confirmation includes exact scope and granularity; a label applying only to a narrower author-specific variant, subargument or stage cannot name a broader page.

When the locked French source attests that an Argument summary is historically absent, English translation preserves the absence: no summary text, length ratio, forceful-expression field or summary-style attestations may be required or invented for that page.

A remote English page newly created as a French-to-English translation uses the exact page-specific edit summary `Translation of the French page: [[:fr:X|X]]`, where X is the locked canonical French title for the same page_id and page type; the signed plan records it, execution recomputes it, and post-write verification confirms it.
sources: owner decision 2026-08-09 — future translation publication conventions
requirements.note: The history link supplements but never replaces the French-page interlanguage link required once English is ready or published.

requirements.statement: A French page that newly receives its locked English interlanguage link uses the exact edit summary `Ajout du lien interlangue vers la page anglaise : [[:en:X|X]]`; the signed update plan records it and execution verifies it.
sources: owner decision 2026-08-09 — future translation publication conventions
requirements.note: Applies to new interlanguage-link operations and does not rewrite historical summaries.

requirements.statement: Every newly created English page produced as a French-to-English translation receives both MediaWiki change tags `chatgpt` and `translated-fr` on its creation revision.
sources: owner decision 2026-08-09 — future translation publication conventions

requirements.statement: A newly created English Argument translated from French must not contain initialization; the French parent-page initialization identifier is wiki-local and is never copied or translated to the English wiki.
sources: owner decision 2026-08-10 — English translation creation metadata

requirements.statement: For every newly created English page translated from French, creation-date is the civil date of the actual remote publication, not the French creation date or the local translation/render date; the signed publication plan must be regenerated if that civil day changes before execution.
sources: owner decision 2026-08-10 — English translation creation metadata
